messages:
maya: Quick handoff — day shift summary. Pools healthy overall but saw a 2x sustained spike from customer `datawise` at ~15:20 UTC. pool-gpu-2 went from ~40% to ~80% burst usage for ~12m, KV cache hitrate stayed ~88%. No alerts fired, left a soft quota note.

maya: Actions I took: scaled pool-gpu-2 burst to 140 for 20m (manual), kicked a cache-warm job for heavy prefixes, and opened a short ticket (INFR-4721) to trace the batch source. I didn't change autoscale configs.

liam: Thanks — I can cover the first half of the night (18:00–01:00 UTC). I have a non-blocking deploy at 00:30 that I'll monitor; if anything looks noisy around that time ping me. :thumbsup:

chetan: I can take 01:00–05:00 UTC. If the spike repeats overnight I'll temporarily bump burst limit +10% and revert once headroom returns. Will post the revert timestamp.

maya: @sara can you confirm the scheduled QA batch at 02:15? if it's going to run, maybe nudge QA to shift to 03:30 to avoid stacking.

sara: Confirmed — QA batch job `nightly/large-embeds` is scheduled 02:15–03:00 but it's flexible. I can move to 03:30–04:15 if needed, will coordinate with the release team.

ops-bot: Automated note: monitored metric -> pool-gpu-2.burst_utilization exceeded 75% for 11m at 1779001200. Current burst_limit = 140 (manual override), autoscale_max = 160. Alert thresholds remain default.

chetan: Quick runbook snippet for whoever's on call: to check headroom run: `rcli pool status pool-gpu-2 --json | jq .headroom`

chetan: If headroom < 20% for >5m, consider: 1) increase burst_limit by +10 (temporary), 2) trigger spare-pool-swap to pool-gpu-hot, 3) set a 30m revert.

liam: I'll take first look if anything spikes after 19:00. If I need to swap earlier I'll post here and @chetan can pick up.

maya: FYI leaving these extra context links: Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abcd/pool-gpu-2?orgId=1 (span=30m), Ticket INFR-4721 link: https://issues.redwood.ai/browse/INFR-4721.

maya: No customer-facing impact observed, just FYI. Handing off now — be aware of QA window + possible datawise repeat. :wave:
